description: SkyHelios supports spatial analysis of urban thermal conditions, including the influence of three-dimensional surroundings on radiation and wind. The authors describe applications at district scale and fine spatial resolution, with resolution selected for the scenario. Their joint methods chapter distinguishes this spatial model from RayMan point calculations and cites several applications. Licence: not stated for the resource; the describing article (doi:10.3390/atmos9060209) is CC-BY-4.0. Published by MDPI AG (publisher of the named authors’ study). Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. Access is through the provider documentation and software links; no software was installed. Cost or acquisition terms remain to be confirmed with the provider. Potential simulation uses include climate adaptation, optimisation. Related catalogue records: platform-umep-urban-multi-scale-environmental-predictor. These are contextual links, not a claim of a tested integration.
